subject: egg-eating snake
title: This Snake Has Almost No Teeth and Swallows Eggs Wider Than Its Head

scenes.text: This snake has almost no teeth. It doesn't need them.
The African egg-eating snake lives on bird eggs alone, and it can take one as big as a chicken's.
The egg is far wider than its head. Its skin stretches until the egg slides down its neck whole.
Then spikes on its neck bones, pointing into its throat, saw through the shell.
It squeezes out the liquid and spits the crushed shell back out in one piece.
Scientists at the University of Cincinnati say it swallows the biggest prey for its size of any snake. Bigger than a python.

description:
This snake has almost no teeth, and it doesn't need them.
The African egg-eating snake feeds only on bird eggs, taking eggs as large as a chicken's even though its own head is far narrower. Spines on its neck vertebrae project into its throat and crack the shell, the contents are squeezed out, and the empty shell is regurgitated. A 2023 study at the University of Cincinnati found that for its size, this slender snake swallows larger prey than any snake measured, including the Burmese python.
Which animal has the strangest way of eating?
first_comment: It fasts for months between nesting seasons, then eats nothing but eggs. What is the weirdest diet in the animal kingdom?
